text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
choice_data_list: You didn't sleep well last night?
You didn't sleep very well last night, did you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Sì.
Have you ever felt 'sound' coming from the moon?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The moon last night was just like a vibraphone.
With a high, uptempo resonance and sparkle, you see.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: It's only natural to be captivated by such a grand concerto... Whew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Sounds of Earth couldn't get a solid night's sleep.
